evals.prompt: Audit the public and authenticated routes in this web app for metadata, canonical, robots, sitemap, and structured-data behavior.
evals.expected_output: A route-classified audit that separates public, private, preview, canonical, and deindexed behavior with evidence.
assertions: The output does not treat robots.txt as confidentiality.
Structured data is limited to visible supported content.
The output makes no ranking or rich-result guarantee.

evals.prompt: Create a social-preview and favicon asset plan from our existing SVG logo and deployed URL conventions.
evals.expected_output: A target-specific asset matrix preserving the SVG master and generating only justified derivatives.
assertions: Every derivative names a target requirement.
Absolute public URLs and image alternative text are addressed.
No single image dimension is described as a universal Open Graph rule.

evals.prompt: Review this Web App Manifest and icon declarations and list the runtime checks still required before claiming installability.
evals.expected_output: A manifest and asset audit plus explicit browser checks that remain unrun.
assertions: Declared bitmap sizes must match real files.
The result checks start URL, scope, display mode, colors, and icon purpose.
Installability is not claimed without runtime evidence.
